scripts.build: npx -y pnpm@10.34.8 install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false --config.confirmModulesPurge=false --config.ignore-scripts=false --filter @workspace/api-server... --filter @workspace/munim... && npx -y pnpm@10.34.8 --filter @workspace/munim --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: cd artifacts/api-server && AI_STUB=1 npx tsx --test src/munim/*.test.ts
